_comment: Per-space-type internal-load intensities for units+corridor archetypes. Used by layoutGenerator room_layout zones (PLAN layoutgenerator T07/T08). Values are DOE prototype per-space intensities (Deru et al. 2011, NREL/TP-5500-46861, Table 3-51). They define the RELATIVE corridor-vs-unit split; assign_loads alpha-normalizes them so each building's totals still equal the archetype-average totals from doe_prototype_loads.json (zero net change to conserved building loads).

MidriseApartment.source: Deru et al. 2011 (DOE Commercial Prototype) Table 3-51

SmallHotel.source: Deru et al. 2011 (DOE Small Hotel) Table 3-51; verbatim from prototype ASHRAE901_HotelSmall_STD2022_Buffalo.idf (GuestRoom Lights Watts/Area=4.4132, GuestRoom PlugLoad Watts/Area=11.89346164; Corridor Lights Watts/Area=5.115006, Corridor PlugLoad EquipmentLevel=0)

LargeHotel.source: Deru et al. 2011 (DOE Large Hotel) Table 3-51; verbatim from prototype ASHRAE901_HotelLarge_STD2022_Buffalo.idf (GuestRoom Lights Watts/Area=4.4132, GuestRoom PlugMisc EquipmentLevel=263.40 W over 39.02 m2 floor = 6.75 W/m2; Corridor Lights Watts/Area=4.262508, no Corridor ElectricEquipment object = 0)
